_doc: Fleet facts for the shared orchestrate / advance-ongoing-plans skills and scripts/agent-env.sh. Field reference: .agents/_shared/README.md, 'Adding the orchestration layer'.
_maxWorkers: Not CI-bound: ci.yml runs on free GitHub-hosted runners (public repo). The ceiling is the machine — each worker holds a pnpm install, a functions install and, while testing, a JVM Firestore emulator.
_maxConcurrentEmulatorSuites: Measured on the sibling Órdago repo on the same 16 GB WSL2 host: two concurrent emulator suites, not three. Workers run targeted tests and let the PR's CI run the full gate, as AGENTS.md already asks of worktrees.
_worktreeSetup: A fresh worktree has no node_modules, functions/ has its own npm install (AGENTS.md, Commands), and the functions bundle imports @cultuvilla/shared's BUILT output — without `shared:build` every emulator suite dies in the harness's functions build with 'Could not resolve @cultuvilla/shared/…'. Never symlink the main checkout's node_modules in: the workspace links are relative and would resolve to the main checkout's packages.
ciCapacity: GitHub-hosted runners, free for this public repo; ci.yml runs every lane on every PR with no shared lane budget, so PRs do not serialise on CI. A green ci.yml run takes ~5-6 min (measured 2026-10-02).
